baselineInstrumentation.purpose: Measure the existing initial and pre-apply current predicates with the same open-edit-validate helper used by the candidate. No snapshot or comparison optimization is applied.

display: Owned Xvfb 21.1.16 / Openbox 3.6.1, 1600x1000x24; authenticated loopback TCP X11; no installed user session

protocol.engine: offline; native engine synchronization not measured
protocol.cache: warm filesystem/JVM samples; no OS cache eviction
protocol.completion: open future followed by EDT barrier and !isLoadingFile
protocol.heartbeat: One queued EDT callback at a time, every 20ms; queue delay, not display FPS
protocol.phaseAccounting: Capture and validation are elapsed-time phase sums per operation. Validation normally has two invocations before and one after. Four recorded samples also waited for a save and required one additional pre-read validation. Whole-operation EDT CPU is separate CPU accounting. Do not add elapsed phases to CPU time or infer their CPU shares. Nested application phases overlap.
protocol.validationScope: open-edit-validate wraps both ownership and authored-state checks. A retired owner can short-circuit a full scan; every measured open/reopen succeeds and performs its recorded full comparisons. The unchanged actual-window probe retains automatic saving; the four additional validations and their JFR phase timelines are preserved below.
protocol.otherWork: This task ran no builds or tests concurrently with the four timing JVMs. Shared-host activity is not controlled. No timing or GC outliers were removed.
protocol.preliminaryRuns: One earlier baseline-only diagnostic run preceded this series and used a different instrumentation location. It is excluded from this fixed four-JVM comparison, not selected based on timings.
protocol.aggregation: Pool the 20 retained observations (sampleIndex >= 0) across both JVMs of each version per fixture/operation, then compute the median. Warmups are retained as sampleIndex -5 through -1.

validation.baselineNegativeControl: Only the two SGF/GIB JFR count assertions fail: expected one validation, observed two. The other 113 cases pass, including all 48 snapshot tests.
validation.displayCoverage: SavedGameLoadSafetyTest uses real entrypoints and SGF I/O with allocated/stubbed frames (134 cases). ShutdownSaveRaceDesktopTest starts Lizzie.main in a separate JVM and exercises 17 actual-window shutdown/save races.
validation.buildProvenance: Baseline test-compile completed from source. Candidate reused unchanged baseline classes and recompiled the two modified production sources with Maven useIncrementalCompilation=false; affected test source/class hashes match baseline. No repository build/CI settings were changed. This local incremental verification is not a clean full rebuild.
validation.ci: The exact final PR-head required clean build and CI are reported on the pull request; local incremental checks are not a substitute.

candidatePublication.details: Published through the GitHub Git-object API. The published commit has exactly the same complete Git tree as the measured local commit; source blobs and all measurement artifact identities are unchanged.
